feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: The U.S. last held a public execution in the 1930s. The Pentagon wants to change that
entry.summary: The Pentagon says it will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan at Fort Hood, the site of his 2009 mass shooting. That would be the first public execution in the U.S. since the 1930s.

entry.title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
entry.summary: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

entry.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
entry.summary: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.

entry.title: Five children are taken from their parents in 'Fjord,' which won top prize at Cannes
entry.summary: Cristian Mungiu's latest film takes place in a small Norwegian town, where a recently arrived couple stands accused of abusing their children — but in Fjord, the truth is never quite clear.

entry.title: How the oil industry is preparing for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Hurricane Isaias is this season's first Atlantic hurricane, and is on a path to hit the northern Gulf Coast. How is the oil industry preparing?

entry.title: 'Misty Green' squanders its potential
entry.summary: Chris Rock's new movie Misty Green wants to critique Hollywood's treatment of Black women. Instead, it gives star Rosalind Eleazar a half-baked role while Rock plays a moralizing savior we've seen before.

entry.title: Fill in the blank in the quiz: A plague research employee in Russia died from ____
entry.summary: Plus: Nobels! Protests! Ambiguous quotes! A mysterious death in Russia!

entry.title: ChatGPT for Teens has special safeguards. A watchdog group finds most don't work
entry.summary: A study from Common Sense Media says most safeguards in ChatGPT for Teens failed. The chatbot talks to teens like a friend and doesn't alert parents when users talk about self-harm and suicide.

entry.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
entry.summary: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.

entry.title: Republican congressman tries to outrun a potential blue wave in New York toss-up seat
entry.summary: Rep. Mike Lawler, R-NY, is in a tight race for re-election in a toss-up district that could help determine control of Congress in November.
